title: Why 'Get Rich' Gurus Sell You Courses Instead of Doing It
alts: You Paid $1,997 for His System. Why Is He Selling It?
Why Your 'Free Training' Always Ends With an Upsell
line1: It's 2 AM and Dave is about to pay $9,997 for a course on getting rich. If the system really works, why is the guru selling it instead of using it?
summary: Dave joins a free webinar, buys a $1,997 'beginner' workshop, and is one click away from the $9,997 Platinum level. We follow the upsell ladder step by step, using what the FTC found in real cases: one program took more than $125 million while its average member made under $250 a year, and another pushed upsells as high as $41,297. Then the 1848 gold rush shopkeeper who got rich without digging, why the refund guarantee turns into a maze, and the one question that made the sales coach hang up.
